user_instruction: 資料量至少翻10倍 1千萬筆為目標
counting: Distinct accepted, deduplicated episodes in the active new release. Also report independent query identities, conservative source families, actual supervised turns and tokens. Repeated copies, memory-position variants and formatting-only views cannot satisfy the 10M target.
publication: Publish verified waves to the same authorized HF dataset while continuing toward the full target; keep old v1 data out of active configs. Do not report the 10M goal complete at an intermediate wave.
source_expansion: Prioritize licensed contextual QA/RAG, executable or source-verified coding, tool/action trajectories, and basic logical/numerical tasks. Importing static trajectories does not prove local environment execution or a model capability gain.

resources.raw_eviction: Only new source-cache files with pinned upstream revision, full-file hash, completed derived export verification and explicit receipt; never delete historical evidence or unverified source bytes.
